name: Metro Pointe at South Coast
demographics: Metro Pointe attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic spanning middle to upper-middle income households in the Costa Mesa and Orange County area. The center appeals to families and young professionals seeking designer brands at outlet prices, with visitors typically ranging from 25-55 years old with household incomes of $75,000-$150,000. The trade area draws from the affluent South Coast Metro district and surrounding communities, with shoppers who appreciate the combination of off-price luxury retailers and everyday convenience stores. Shopping patterns reflect a mix of planned destination visits for outlet shopping and regular trips for entertainment and dining experiences.
description: Metro Pointe at South Coast is a premier open-air lifestyle destination in Costa Mesa, California, strategically positioned to serve the affluent Orange County market with a unique blend of value-oriented luxury and everyday convenience. This dynamic retail center has established itself as a go-to destination for designer brands at exceptional prices, featuring an impressive lineup of off-price fashion powerhouses including Nordstrom Rack, Saks OFF 5TH, Marshalls, and Bloomingdale's Outlet Store. Beyond fashion, Metro Pointe offers a comprehensive shopping experience with major retailers like Best Buy, The Container Store, Old Navy, and Tilly's, ensuring visitors can accomplish multiple shopping objectives in one convenient location. The center enhances the retail experience with diverse dining options ranging from Karl Strauss Brewery and Restaurant to casual favorites like Starbucks Coffee, Boudin SF, and Cold Stone Creamery, plus entertainment venues including the Edwards Metro Pointe Stadium 12 theater and Kids Empire. With its thoughtfully curated tenant mix, live entertainment programming, and modern open-air design, Metro Pointe has become a beloved community gathering place that combines the thrill of outlet shopping with the convenience of a neighborhood center.
summary: Metro Pointe at South Coast is an open-air lifestyle center in Costa Mesa featuring premier off-price retailers including Nordstrom Rack, Saks OFF 5TH, Marshalls, and Bloomingdale's Outlet alongside popular stores like Best Buy and The Container Store. The center offers a complete shopping and entertainment experience with diverse dining options, Edwards Theatre, and regular live entertainment programming.
